name: Pick Your Own Discount
description: Sets products added from /pages/pick-your-own to $9.90. Requires line item property _pickyourown: true. Other pages keep catalog price.
title: Pick Your Own $9.90 discount
pageHint: Applies only to cart lines added from /pages/pick-your-own.
priceHint: Target price: $9.90 USD per unit. Products already at or below $9.90 are skipped.
saveHint: Save this discount to activate the function configuration.
